_note: Demo data for the public live demo. bellas-cafe.example is the fixture in fixtures/cafe-demo, scanned by the real pipeline (keyword policy path) and renamed from localhost:8765. The other sites are made up. No real site appears here.

findings.title: Intercom chat widget on the homepage
findings.fix: Your site has a chat window from Intercom. That's fine; just make sure it's named in your privacy policy.

findings.title: Chat messages likely go to the US (Intercom)
findings.fix: Intercom is a company based in the US, so this data is likely stored outside the EU. Ask your web person whether Intercom's EU data hosting is switched on.

findings.title: No other outside services on your homepage

evidence.snippet: Only bellas-cafe.example was contacted while the homepage loaded

findings.fix: Nothing to do. If you add analytics, fonts, videos or maps later, name them in your privacy policy and your cookie banner.

findings.title: Secret OpenAI key visible in your site's code
findings.fix: This key works like a password for your OpenAI account, and anyone who views your site's code can copy it and run up charges. Ask your web person to cancel it in your OpenAI account and keep the replacement on your server, out of the page.

findings.title: Has an llms.txt guide for AI assistants
findings.fix: Your llms.txt file tells AI assistants what your business is about. Ask your web person to keep it up to date.

findings.title: Your robots.txt blocks GPTBot, CCBot

evidence.snippet: User-agent: GPTBot | Disallow: / | User-agent: CCBot | Disallow: /

findings.fix: Your robots.txt file tells some AI companies' bots whether they may read your site. Others aren't mentioned, so they follow your general rules. Ask your web person to review the list if that's not what you want.

findings.title: Your site offers AI assistants a way to connect (MCP)
findings.fix: AI assistants can use this connection to look up or do things with your business. Ask your web person to make sure it only shares what you're happy to share.

findings.title: The chat assistant doesn't say it's AI

evidence.snippet: Hi! I'm Bella, how can I help with your order today?

findings.fix: If this chat is run by AI, EU rules (the AI Act) say visitors should be told they're talking to AI. Ask your web person to add a line like 'I'm an AI assistant' to the greeting.

findings.title: Privacy policy doesn't mention OpenAI

evidence.snippet: We use Intercom to answer customer messages on our website.

findings.fix: Your site uses OpenAI but your privacy policy doesn't say so. Ask your web person to add a line naming OpenAI and what it's used for.

findings.title: Privacy policy doesn't mention AI or chatbots

evidence.snippet: No mention of AI, chatbots or automated processing

findings.fix: Your site uses AI tools. Ask your web person to add a short line to your privacy policy saying what they are used for.

findings.title: Tidio chat widget on the homepage
findings.fix: Your site has a Tidio chat window. Make sure it's in your privacy policy.

findings.title: Chat messages likely go to the US (Tidio)
findings.fix: Tidio is a US company. Ask your web person where Tidio stores your patients' messages.

findings.title: Couldn't tell if the chat says it's AI
findings.fix: We couldn't see the chat greeting without opening it. Check it says it's an AI assistant if it is one.

findings.title: Privacy policy doesn't mention Tidio

evidence.snippet: We use cookies to improve your experience.

findings.fix: Patients' chat messages go to Tidio, but your privacy policy doesn't say so. Add a line naming Tidio.

findings.title: Google key in your site's code (probably Maps)
findings.fix: This looks like a Google Maps key, which is normally public. Ask your web person to make sure it's restricted to your website.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.fix: Optional: a short llms.txt helps AI assistants describe your practice correctly.

findings.title: No rules for AI crawlers
findings.fix: AI crawlers are treated like any other visitor. That's a choice, not a problem.

findings.title: Crisp chat widget on the homepage
findings.fix: Your site has a Crisp chat window. Crisp is based in the EU.

findings.title: Chat says it's an AI assistant

evidence.snippet: Hi, I'm Ivy, an AI assistant for Oak & Ivy.

findings.fix: Good: visitors know they're talking to AI.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.fix: Optional: a short llms.txt helps AI assistants describe your shop correctly.
